tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Name, time zone, currency, languages and the item types this business accepts.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Bookable services with duration and price. A price per person (price.per = person) is for each person in the booking: send partySize, and the total is the price times it.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Orderable products with prices in minor units.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free start times for a service between two instants (at most 14 days). A time that has started, or that starts within the business's minimum notice, is not offered.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask for a price on something custom. Creates a quote_request item.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Request a service at a time. Check availability first. A fixed-price service costs the business's price from list_services; a different totalPrice you send is only noted for the business. Returns the item and, if you have no account, an access_token.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Order products. Prices are in minor units. A line naming a product (productId or sku) costs the business's price from list_products, and the total follows; a different price you send is only noted for the business. A line naming no product waits for the business to price it.

tools.name: get_item_status
tools.description: The current state of an item you created, in the business's words: what it proposed and waits for your person to answer (offer, with its terms_sha), who it waits on, what they can do next, and the conversation so far (thread: the business's replies and your person's messages).

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: Accept another time the business proposed for a booking, or its quote. This binds your person, so send terms_sha — offer.terms_sha from get_item_status — only after they said yes to offer.human. Without terms_sha nothing is booked: you get the terms to show them. An accepted quote becomes a confirme

tools.name: decline_offer
tools.description: Say no to another time the business proposed (the booking request is closed) or to its quote. Add reason for anything your person wants the business to know.

tools.name: suggest_time
tools.description: Instead of the time the business proposed, ask for another: start_time must be one of the free times check_availability lists (the end follows the service's length). The business confirms it or proposes again.

tools.name: provide_details
tools.description: Answer what the business asked about an item (get_item_status says it needs a detail). The item moves on; on any other item your details are kept as a message for the business.

tools.name: cancel_item
tools.description: Cancel an item you created. After the business's cancellation window, a confirmed booking is cancelled late where the business records late cancellations (it may count against the customer), and refused where it does not.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Start a conversation, or reply on an item you own.

tools.name: acknowledge_receipt
tools.description: Counter-sign a receipt this item earned, so both sides hold it. Read the item to find its receipts; then send a compact JWS signed with your own Ed25519 key — header {alg:'EdDSA', typ:'sdi-receipt-ack+jws', jwk:<your public jwk>}, payload {rcp:<receipt id>, sha:<base64url(SHA-256(receipt jws))>, iat

tools.name: verify_customer
tools.description: When a result says identity.recognised is weak, the person gave the email of a customer the business knows. Call this with item_id and access_token to email them six digits; ask the person for the code and call it again with code. Then the business recognises them.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_booking" references sensitive artifacts (access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_item_status · Private data: cancel_item · Public sink: list_services, create_booking, create_order, accept_offer, send_message, acknowledge_receipt, verify_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_item_status · Private data: cancel_item · Public sink: list_services, create_booking, create_order, accept_offer, send_message, acknowledge_receipt, verify_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
